note: Crafts of the Somatic Reaches/Cogitarium (body_mind axis). Soma is the body-pole tradition (the physical masteries, the body as instrument); Noesis the mind-pole (mental disciplines, memory-palaces, thought as force). Learned by traveling the Reach or training with Somatics/Cogitants. Both drift the wielder toward their pole; the perfected athlete-scholar is where they co-fire, the disembodied Cogitant where mind wins absolutely. axes signed for engine compat. Authored by Aevi (PO), SNG-016 — the last of the six near-axis traditions.

abilities.name: Soma
abilities.narrationHints: The body made instrument — breath, poise, endurance past what should be possible, movement as a language spoken without words.
abilities.description: Control breath and heartbeat to steady fear, pain and cold; endure past the ordinary; move with a precision that reads as grace. The body-pole mastery — the Flesh-Temples' art.
abilities.notFor: Thought-work or memory (that's Noesis); brute force alone (Soma is control, not just strength); anything requiring you to leave the body behind.

tree.name: The Trained Body
tree.grants: Endurance and poise past the ordinary; control breath and heartbeat to steady fear, pain, or cold; move with a precision that reads as grace.
tree.cannot: The body still has limits; Soma raises the ceiling, it doesn't remove it.

tree.name: The Instrument
tree.grants: Feats of body that look impossible — hold a bridge-pose an hour, run past collapse, slow your own bleeding, take a blow and keep the form; teach the body a skill in days that takes others years.
tree.cannot: Pushing past the true limit still breaks you; the body remembers what you spend.

tree.name: The Perfected Vessel
tree.grants: The body as a mastered whole — survive what kills others, perform at the edge of the humanly possible, make the physical self answer the will completely. AND THE BODY AS THE INSTRUMENT IT IS: a strike thrown with the whole mastered frame behind it — stance, breath, and timing arriving together — wounds far past what the same arm could do untrained.
tree.cannot: The wielder drifts body-hot — and the Temple that rejects thought forgets to warn itself; a perfected body with a starved mind is its own foreclosure, mastery with nothing left to aim it.

mechanic.note: damaging rung — soma includes striking, but its shape is BOLSTER: it raises what the body can do

rankDeltas.delta: FEATS THAT LOOK IMPOSSIBLE — hold a bridge-pose an hour, run past collapse, SLOW YOUR OWN BLEEDING, take a blow and keep the line
SPECIAL: the body as A MASTERED WHOLE — survive what kills others, perform at the edge of the humanly possible

intensity.conserve: steady the body — half the capacity, and no debt
intensity.surge: double it; THE WIELDER DRIFTS BODY-HOT, and the Temple that rejects thought entirely is a warning

bounds.text: THE BODY STILL HAS LIMITS — Soma raises the ceiling, IT DOES NOT REMOVE IT
pushing past the TRUE limit still breaks you

abilities._descriptionWas: The body-pole mastery: breath-control, endurance, poise, the physical self honed to an instrument. The Flesh-Temples' art.

abilities.name: Noesis
abilities.narrationHints: Thought made a discipline and a force — memory-palaces, absolute focus, reasoning that outruns the room, the mind holding what the body can't.
abilities.description: Recall perfectly what you attend to, focus past pain and fear, and reason a problem faster and further than the unpracticed. The mind-pole mastery — the Cogitarium's art.
abilities.notFor: Physical feats (that's Soma); wisdom (Noesis is sharp, not necessarily wise); anything requiring presence in the body it keeps trying to leave.

tree.name: The Ordered Mind
tree.grants: Perfect recall of what you attend to; focus that ignores pain, fear, and distraction; reason a problem faster and further than the unpracticed.
tree.cannot: Recall is not understanding; focus this tight can miss the body's warnings.

tree.name: The Memory-Palace
tree.grants: Hold vast structured knowledge and retrieve it instantly; model a system or a person in your head and predict them; think through a crisis in the space others panic in.
tree.cannot: The model is only as good as its inputs; a mind that lives in the model loses the room.

tree.name: The Cogitant's Height
tree.grants: Thought as force — solve the unsolvable, hold a hundred threads at once, out-think a situation so completely you seem to move before it does. And turned on a person: a conclusion assembled and delivered exactly where their reasoning rests, which staggers a mind the way a blow staggers a body, and leaves the same kind of mark.
tree.cannot: It is sharp, not wise, and this use of it least of all. It needs a mind that reasons — the disciplined, the genuinely mad, and the simply uninterested all shrug it off. And the Cogitarium teaches that what you take apart in someone this way, you are responsible for putting back.

SPECIAL: THOUGHT AS FORCE — solve the unsolvable, hold a hundred threads at once, out-think a situation so completely you seem to have arranged it

intensity.conserve: think it through — half the reach, and it costs you no time

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.narrationHints: Past the wall, and the body finds more.
abilities.description: Push the body past exhaustion, pain, or shock for a burst — folk-Soma.

tree.name: Second Wind
tree.grants: Ignore pain, fatigue, or shock for a short, decisive burst of physical effort.
tree.cannot: The body remembers the debt; overuse breaks you.

tree.name: The Third Wind
tree.grants: Find breath and strength past where the body had none — twice, in one day, at a cost. And what you find is not simply more of what you had: for as long as it lasts you are stronger and faster than your own rested self, which is exactly why it costs what it costs.
tree.cannot: The body is borrowing from tomorrow, and tomorrow collects with interest.

tree.name: The Wind That Doesn't End
tree.grants: Go on past exhaustion for as long as the thing needs doing — the body simply does not stop. And it tends itself as it runs: bleeding slows, shock recedes, the worst of the damage held off until the work is finished.
tree.cannot: Held off is not healed — everything deferred arrives at once when you stop, and it arrives worse. This is borrowing, at a rate the Flesh-Temples consider usurious.

abilities.name: Perfect Motion

abilities.notFor: Feats past the body's true ceiling; thought-work.

tree.name: The Unwasted Motion

tree.cannot: Efficiency is not power. A perfect motion still loses to a stronger one.

abilities.name: Memory-Palace
abilities.narrationHints: They go still and their eyes track across nothing, left to right, like someone reading. Then they tell you where they have seen that man before.
abilities.description: Search your own memory the way you would search a library — cross-reference a face, a hand, a phrase against everything you have ever attended to, and find the match.
abilities.notFor: Wisdom; presence in the body it forgets.

tree.name: The Near Rooms
tree.grants: ⛔ SEARCH WHAT YOU HAVE ATTENDED TO IN RECENT WEEKS AND FIND THE MATCH — the face at this gate was at that funeral, the same hand signed both ledgers, this phrase was in a letter you read.
tree.cannot: Only what you ATTENDED to, and only weeks back. Background you did not look at was never stored.

tree.name: The Whole House
tree.grants: ⚠️ ADDS DEPTH OF TIME. The search runs across your entire life — childhood, the war, a road you walked once twenty years ago — and returns it whole: tone, order, who said what, and what was not said.
tree.cannot: Still only your own attending. A long search takes a quiet minute you may not have.

tree.name: The Borrowed Room
tree.grants: ⛔ ADDS SOMEONE ELSE. Enter a willing — or unresisting — mind and search THEIR memory the same way. The dying man's last road, the witness who saw it and cannot say it, the prisoner who does not know what they know.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ A RESISTING MIND CAN REFUSE, and a hostile one costs you. You get what THEY attended to, including what they were wrong about.

abilities.notFor: Body-heavy or mind-heavy wielders (needs both near-equal); the extremes.

tree.cannot: Needs both trained near-equal; the pure poles cannot do it.

You act with perception, decision and motion as one instant, taking your action before the round resolves rather than in it. It sets up rather than strikes: what it buys is going first with full information, which is usually worth more than the blow you would have thrown.

abilities.name: The Pathless Way
abilities.narrationHints: The unclimbable is climbed, the uncrossable crossed — the body finds a way where there is none.

abilities.notFor: Teleportation or flight (it's mastery, not magic); carrying others easily; ignoring true lethality unwarned.

tree.cannot: The truly impossible (a sheer mile of ice in a storm) still exacts a price; you can fail, spectacularly, and the fall is real.

abilities.name: Skydancer

abilities.notFor: Sustained hovering or true flight (it's bursts, momentum-bound); carrying heavy loads aloft.

tree.cannot: Momentum-bound (you must keep moving, no hover); a mistimed step falls; heavy burden grounds you.

tree.cannot: Still momentum-bound; there is no hover at any mastery, only better momentum. Carrying another halves your reach and a mistimed step now falls two people. Heavy burden still grounds you outright.

abilities.name: The Working Model
abilities.narrationHints: They stand still for a long moment doing nothing visible, and then work without pausing once, and there are no offcuts.
abilities.description: Model a thing so completely in your head that the making is only following the thought — and build it faster and truer than your tools should allow.

tree.name: The Single Thing
tree.grants: ⛔ ONE ITEM, OR A SPACE YOU CAN STAND IN AND SEE. A lock, a brace, a splint, a door, a cart-repair, a small room re-laid. You need no plan and you waste no material.
tree.cannot: One object or one small space at a time. You must be able to examine it.

tree.name: The Whole Working
tree.grants: ⚠️ ADDS SYSTEMS AND COMPOUNDS. A machine with parts that move against each other, a building, a body, a workshop yard — anything whose pieces have to agree. Diagnose its faults and redesign it from the inside.
tree.cannot: You must have access to the whole of it; a system half-hidden is modelled half-wrong.

tree.name: The Modelled Country
tree.grants: ⛔ ADDS COMPLEXITY AND DISTRICT SCALE. A mill and its race, a fortification and its approaches, a quarter's drainage. Held entire, and rebuilt entire.
tree.cannot: One such working at a time, and you must be able to get around the whole of it.

abilities.name: The Shaped Body

abilities.name: The Unmoving Mind
abilities.narrationHints: Everything they throw at your thoughts slides off a stillness that was there before they arrived and will be there after they tire. You did not brace. You were simply already still.
abilities.description: Enter a stillness nothing can move — fear, pain, deception and the fastest attack all slide off it, and you keep reading the room while they try.
abilities.notFor: It is defense and clarity, never force — you cannot strike with stillness, only see and endure. And a mind held perfectly still holds nothing else; while you are unmoving you are only unmoving.

tree.name: The Still Mind
tree.grants: Enter a stillness fear, pain and distraction do not reach. You think and work clean while the room comes apart.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ It occupies you — entering it means standing still and doing one thing.

tree.name: Stillness While Moving
tree.grants: ⛔ ADDS ACTING. Hold it while fighting, walking, negotiating or climbing — the clarity comes with you instead of costing you the scene.
tree.cannot: You are calm, not faster. It does not help you win, only stop losing to yourself.

tree.name: Nothing Lands

tree.cannot: ⛔ A true thing you cannot bear is still true. This turns aside what is AIMED at you, not what is so.

abilities._descriptionWas: The Cogitant art of mushin — no-mind, the perfect stillness that nothing can move: not fear, not deception, not the fastest attack, because a mind that does not flinch reads everything and grants nothing. The blade-discipline made total.

_treeWas.name: The Unmoving Mind
_treeWas.grants: Enter a perfect mental stillness — immune to fear, deception, and disruption, reading all with total clarity.
_treeWas.cannot: It grants no offense, only the unshakeable read; it occupies you wholly to hold; and a stillness this deep can look, to those who love you, like you have gone somewhere they cannot follow.

_treeWas.name: The Moving Stillness
_treeWas.grants: The stillness no longer occupies you wholly — hold it while fighting, walking, negotiating, and the clarity holds with it. And it reaches past you: those who stand with you and trust you are steadied by proximity, and do not break when they should.
_treeWas.cannot: Extending it thins it — the more you shelter, the less clearly you read. It still grants no offense at any depth. And those sheltered feel the flinch you are not having, which more than one person has found worse than their own fear.

abilities._merged: ⛔ SNG-457: MERGES Total Focus (L1, e4) — whose three ranks were one sentence with intensifiers: 'fear, pain and distraction fall away' → 'stop reaching you' → 'nothing else exists'. ⚠️ THE UNMOVING MIND'S r2 WAS THE ONLY REAL ADVANCE IN EITHER — 'hold it while fighting, walking, negotiating' — and it had only two ranks. One skill now, and each rank adds a thing: stillness → stillness while acting → deception slides off too.

abilities.name: The Single Stroke
abilities.narrationHints: You have already seen it — the one moment, the only opening, the single stroke that ends the contest before it was properly a contest. You do not rush. You wait for the instant you already know is coming, and then it simply is.
abilities.description: The Cogitant capstone — mind and act become one perfect stroke, the whole contest read to its single decisive instant and then delivered without waste. The sword-saint's art: not the fastest blade, the ONLY necessary one.
abilities.notFor: One stroke, read and delivered perfectly, at enormous cost of focus — and it demands the opening be real; against something with no decisive instant (a flood, a crowd, a lie with no center) there is no single stroke to find.

tree.name: The Single Stroke
tree.grants: Read a contest to its one decisive instant and deliver the single perfect stroke that ends it — one strike, placed where a contest breaks.
tree.cannot: It costs nearly all your focus, it requires a real decisive instant to exist, and it is the blade's truth and the pen's alike — some contests have no single stroke, and mistaking that is how the sure-handed fall.

mechanic.note: T-V capstone, lethal. The highest marginFloorPer in the catalog: this craft IS the decisive margin — 'read a contest to its ONE DECISIVE INSTANT.'

rankDeltas.delta: SPECIAL: READ A CONTEST TO ITS ONE DECISIVE INSTANT and deliver the single perfect stroke that ends it. The capstone is a KIND (ending a contest by seeing it whole) at near-total focus-cost.

intensity.conserve: REFUSED — a half-committed single stroke is just a strike, and it will not end anything.
intensity.surge: REFUSED — it already costs nearly all your focus.

bounds.text: IT COSTS NEARLY ALL YOUR FOCUS
IT REQUIRES A REAL DECISIVE INSTANT — a contest without one offers nothing

abilities.plainly: A fight action that deals damage. It rolls 5d6+6 It affects 1 target Limit: iT Costs Nearly All Your Focus.

abilities.name: The Taken Apart
abilities.narrationHints: They read the body the way a mason reads a wall, and then they go to the seams.
abilities.description: ⚠️ THE BREAKERS' CRAFT. A body is a structure, and a somatic who has mastered their own knows exactly where another one comes apart. Joint, then rhythm, then nerve. It is precise, it is unhurried, and it is entirely survivable right up until it is not.
abilities.notFor: Anything not built like a body. Speed — this is not a fast kill and was never meant to be; a Breaker who is rushed does damage and nothing more.

tree.name: The Taken Apart
tree.grants: Go to the seams — joints and rhythm. They stop being able to fight long before they stop.
tree.cannot: A fast resolution. Non-bodies.

tree.name: The Last Seam
tree.grants: Continue past fighting-stopped to stopped. Precise, and the practitioner is never in doubt about which they did.
tree.cannot: : there is no ambiguity available; the tradition does not let you claim you did not mean to.

mechanic.note: ⚠️ SLOW and precise — r1 incapacitates, r2 continues. The two-step IS the craft: a Breaker always passes through 'they cannot fight' on the way.

rankDeltas.delta: SPECIAL: continue past fighting-stopped to stopped

intensity.conserve: seams only — they cannot fight, and they live
intensity.surge: the last seam; THERE IS NO AMBIGUITY AVAILABLE ABOUT WHICH YOU DID

bounds.text: BODIES ONLY
IT IS SLOW — a rushed Breaker only does damage
IT PASSES THROUGH 'THEY CANNOT FIGHT' FIRST, so continuing is a SECOND DECISION

abilities.plainly: A fight or duel attack resolving in two steps. Rank 1 deals 4d6 plus 1 and reduces the target's ability to fight; rank 2 continues from there to a lethal result. You always pass through the first step, so continuing is a separate decision the GM will make you state aloud. It is slow — if you are rushed or interrupted you only get the first step. It works only on things built like bodies.

abilities.name: The Answered Motion
abilities.narrationHints: You read the body's next movement in the movement before it, and put your hand exactly where that movement is going. Joints go the wrong way. Weight arrives where they were not standing. Nothing wasted, nothing telegraphed, all of it at contact range.
abilities.description: Meet a committed movement and finish it wrong — an elbow past its travel, a knee folded inward, a wrist that will not close on a weapon again today. Real breakage at contact range, and the Somatics' first offense: not force but ANSWER.
abilities.notFor: Reach (this is a hand's length; a spear is a real answer to it); the motionless (a set, braced, patient opponent gives you almost nothing); crowds — it is one body at a time; anything whose body you cannot read.

tree.name: The Turned Joint
tree.grants: Meet a committed movement and finish it wrong — an elbow past its travel, a knee folded inward, a wrist that will not close on a weapon again today. Real breakage at contact range.
tree.cannot: CONTACT RANGE ONLY and they must be MOVING. A braced, patient opponent offers nothing to answer; a polearm keeps you out entirely.

tree.name: The Given Fall
tree.grants: Take their weight as well as their limb — put a body into the ground, a wall, a stairwell, or another body, using what they brought.
tree.cannot: The harder they come, the harder it lands — which cuts both ways when you misread. A second opponent while you are inside the first one's motion is how Somatics die.

tree.name: The Whole Answer
tree.grants: Every motion answered as it arrives, for as long as they keep making them. Necks, spines, and the base of the skull are motions like any other.
tree.cannot: ⚠ IT ONLY WORKS ON THE MOVING. Someone who simply stops — sets a shield, waits, brings up a bow at ten paces — is a problem this craft has no answer for at all.

intensity.conserve: turn the joint and let go
intensity.surge: answer everything; IT ONLY WORKS ON THE MOVING — a man who stops is beyond you

bounds.text: CONTACT RANGE ONLY
they must be MOVING — the braced and patient give nothing
one body at a time
reach beats it — a spear keeps you out

abilities.plainly: A fight action that turns an opponent's own movement into their injury. Rated 7 of 10 on one target. Limit: contact range, and they must be moving.
abilities.backlash: You read the motion wrong and finish INTO it. Their weight arrives where you are, and you take the strike you were answering.
abilities.conserveSuppresses: turn the joint and let go — a misread costs position, not bone
abilities._backlashRungNote: SNG-359 CORRECTION 2026-08-08: my first split was intrinsic-vs-placed — does the CRAFT route through the wielder. That is the wrong question. The only question a backlash rung answers is: DOES THIS FAILURE HARM THE WIELDER? A placed craft that comes down on the person who placed it harms them just as surely as a conduit craft that reverses. 9 of the 12 I had left unset do harm the wielder and now carry a rung.

abilities.name: The Sustained Regard
abilities.narrationHints: You give them the whole of your attention and refuse to give it back. Under a regard that complete the body starts dropping the things it was doing unattended — balance, breath, the grip on a weapon, the clotting of a wound.
abilities.description: Fix the whole of your attention on one person in sight and refuse to give it back. Balance, breath, grip and the clotting of a wound all falter. No vector, no contact — the Cogitants' first offense.
abilities.notFor: Anything you cannot see or have not met; several at once (it is ALL of your attention, that is the whole mechanism); acting well yourself while you hold it; the disciplined, who can hold their own attention against yours.

tree.name: The Whole of It
tree.grants: Fix the entirety of your attention on one person in sight. Autonomic things falter — vision greys, a limb goes uncertain, breath stumbles, an open wound stops closing. They know they are being looked at and cannot say why it hurts.
tree.cannot: ONE TARGET, and it costs you nearly all of your own action while it holds. A trained mind resists and knows what you are doing. Break line of sight and it ends.

tree.name: The Held Regard
tree.grants: Keep it. What their body was running unattended stays unrun — they cannot rally, cannot steady, cannot stop bleeding, for as long as you look.
tree.cannot: You are doing nothing else. ⚠ A SECOND ENEMY WHILE YOU HOLD THIS IS HOW COGITANTS DIE. No one else takes a harm rung from it, and no one else can lift it for you; only the wielder can drop it.

tree.name: The Undivided
tree.grants: Attention at a weight a body cannot be looked at under. Things stop. Hearts are things. AND YOU KEEP YOURSELF NOW: the wielder no longer stops running their own body to do it, and can act while the regard holds.
tree.cannot: Still ONE TARGET, still line of sight, and a trained mind still knows what you are doing and who is doing it. The Discarnate reach this rank and then keep going, which is how they stop coming back.
